summary: The sum of three consecutive odd integers is 51. Find the three integers.

steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Let the three consecutive odd integers}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{be }x,x+2,x+4\\[5pt]&x+(x+2)+(x+4)=51\\[5pt]&3x+6=51\\[5pt]&3x=45\\[5pt]&x=15\\[5pt]&\text{The three consecutive odd integers are}\\[5pt]&\quad \textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{15,17}\textbf{ and }\mathbf{19}}\text{.}\end{aligned}\]
